title: emdash-cms/emdash
claim: emdash-cms/emdash — EmDash is a full-stack TypeScript CMS based on Astro; the spiritual successor to WordPress
why_good: A full-stack TypeScript CMS on Astro pitched as WordPress's successor — a huge market where a modern, JS-native CMS has real pull.
value: Hosting + themes + agency/enterprise licenses — the classic WordPress-economy playbook on a modern stack.
risk: WordPress's moat is its plugin/theme ecosystem and installed base; 'successor' claims are common and rarely dislodge it.
pick_reason: EmDash offers a clear product that can be monetized by targeting developers looking for modern CMS solutions.

zh.claim: emdash-cms/emdash —— 基于 Astro 的全栈 TypeScript CMS,WordPress 的精神继承者。
zh.why_good: 一个基于 Astro 的全栈 TS CMS,定位为 WordPress 继承者——一个大市场,现代、JS 原生的 CMS 确有吸引力。
zh.value: 托管 + 主题 + 代理商/企业授权,在现代技术栈上复刻 WordPress 经济的经典打法。
zh.risk: WordPress 的护城河是插件/主题生态和存量;继承者的口号很常见,极少能撼动它。
